Quest name: City to the Underworld (Chrono Quest - B.C.)
Quest location: Seville Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r9 Recognition, r11 Archaeology, GRE(Greek)
Pre-requisite discovery: The City of the Dead discovery (from "Enter underground map") + Archaeological Area of Troy discovery (from "Troy" quest)(hidden)

comments.body:
1) Speak with Barkeep in Salonika 2x

3) Go to Hisarlik Hill (inland from Turkey West Coast) and use observe and recognition in the far Southeast Corner
